title: Tarball extraction keeps a relative symlink that stays inside the top directory
objective: In src/wev_skills/third_party/fetch.py, install_version(source, release: Release, home: Path, opener, runner) extracts a GitHub release tarball under home/<source>/<version>. Keep extracted symlinks inside the top directory of the archive: accept a link whose target resolves to a path within the top directory, and refuse with CheckFailed("unsafe_member") any link that resolves outside it or that would alias the top directory itself (for example a link to the directory it sits in, or a chain of links that climbs back out). Nothing may be left under home after a refusal.
